title: Intervention-driven exemplar regression check and CI adapter

description: Motivation: Flaky prompt-set regressions often surface only under small interventions (token edits, paraphrase anchors, or inserted context). This PR introduces an intervention-driven exemplar regression check that runs targeted interventions against developer prompt sets to surface semantic alignment regressions early. What this changes: 1) new check `exemplar_intervention_check` that accepts a configurable set of interventions (token-level edits, paraphrase generators, context insertions) and computes a Contrastive Anchor Score (CAS) and delta from baseline; 2) CI adapter `intervention_smoke_adapter` that can be wired into PR pipelines as an optional smoke stage; adapter emits structured diff artifact and human-readable report to make remediation actionable; 3) lightweight calibrator that computes a per-prompt baseline and per-cohort thresholds using historical samples; 4) docs and tuning guide with recommended default thresholds and rollback hints. Usage notes: the adapter is opt-in via pipeline feature-flag and defaults to a conservative threshold to avoid noisy fails; for critical release branches it can be promoted to fail-on-regression. Link to project plan: Linear ENG-4721. Checklist: - [x] feature implementation - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] CI pipeline integration - [x] docs and examples - [x] perf sanity checks (local) Backwards compatibility: the default remains no-op unless the adapter is enabled in CI. Rollout plan: staged opt-in on repo-level smoke pipelines followed by organization-wide adoption if signal quality is good. Monitoring: the adapter publishes metrics (cases_run, regressions_detected, cas_delta_histogram) to the harness metrics namespace. Security/Privacy: no new telemetry beyond existing eval payloads; see docs for opt-out.
